data_description.local_first: Try HA native intents first (instant), use Ollama only when HA doesn't understand. Don't also enable 'Prefer handling commands locally'.
data_description.warmup: Preload model and prompt into Ollama's cache at startup and when entities change.
data_description.num_ctx: Context window. Use the same value in every app using this model, or Ollama reloads it.
data_description.num_thread: CPU threads. 0 = auto. On hybrid Intel CPUs try the number of performance cores.
data_description.max_tokens: Max response length. A tool call uses about 50.
data_description.max_devices: Max entities in the prompt (controllable devices first).
data_description.include_sensors: Include exposed sensors to answer questions.
